common_prompt: Create one square 1:1 album cover illustration, final production art for the Vozen Music station named below. No lettering, numbers, logos, watermarks, borders or UI. Original hand-drawn 2D anime background art with delicate ink lines, flat gouache color, quiet everyday detail, imperfect painted texture; nostalgic late-1990s animation background, refined lo-fi record sleeve, believable perspective. Avoid glossy 3D, photographic realism, neon cyberpunk, lens flare, generic AI fantasy, floating objects. Composition must read clearly as a small square thumbnail while rewarding closer inspection. This is part of a cohesive series, each cover tells a different scene.

covers.prompt: LOFI: An intimate Japanese hillside porch at warm peach sunset, worn wooden turntable on a low table next to a half-finished cup of tea, potted flowers and a distant seaside town. Soft dusty sage, apricot, faded navy. Still, lived-in, not overly busy.

AMBIENT: A lone weathered wooden observation deck among quiet blue-green mountain ridges, a small open notebook on its bench, drifting layers of low mist and a pale early-morning sky. Desaturated seafoam, silver-blue, ivory. Atmospheric space, no people.

JAZZ: A tiny after-hours jazz bar with a honey-colored upright double bass leaning beside a dark green velvet chair, brass saxophone in its open case, muted city window and two warm table lamps. Burgundy, tobacco brown, mustard, deep petrol. Intimate hand-painted interior, no text.

ELECTRONIC: A small rooftop music studio overlooking an ordinary city at blue hour, compact analog synthesizer with patch cables on a desk, headphones, a small potted fern and lavender-blue sky through the open door. Indigo, muted coral, cool teal, tiny amber lights. Quiet electrical energy, no futuristic neon.

PIANO: An old upright piano beside a tall open window, thin ivory curtains moving in a summer breeze, afternoon light on the wooden keys, a small vase of wildflowers and a garden beyond. Faded olive, warm cream, honey wood, soft powder blue. Calm, tender, tactile painted detail.

CINEMATIC: A solitary small coastal railway platform at dawn, empty wooden bench and vintage luggage, railway tracks curve toward distant mountains and a vast pale gold sky with layered clouds. Deep slate blue, dusty gold, muted terra cotta. Wide emotional storytelling within a square painting.

ROCK: A beloved basement rehearsal room after the band has left: red electric guitar leaning against a worn amplifier, coiled instrument cable on an old patterned rug, small high window with evening light, faded wall paint. Brick red, faded denim, dusty charcoal, warm amber. Hand-drawn cozy indie music atmosphere, no posters with writing.

NIGHT: A quiet steep Japanese residential lane seen from above descending toward city lights, utility cables across a vast dark teal sky, a narrow strip of orange sunset far at the horizon, one small warm-lit doorway. Deep blue-black, petrol, tiny soft amber lights. Restrained inked 2D night illustration, no people.

RAIN: A small Japanese neighborhood alley during gentle rain at pink dusk, tiled roofs, a bicycle resting by a mint-green house, potted plants outside a little cafe with warm window light, puddles reflecting peach sky, fine visible rain strokes. Dusty rose, sage, slate purple, soft golden windows. Cozy atmospheric drawn scene.

SLEEP: An unoccupied cozy bedroom at night, loosely folded indigo bedding, open window framing a thin crescent moon over dark trees, linen curtains with soft lavender light, closed book on the bedside table. Midnight blue, muted violet, warm cream. Quiet sleepy hand-drawn background art, no luminous surreal sky.

MY STATION: A personal listening corner by a big window: a small wooden shelf of hand-decorated blank record sleeves, a turntable, well-used headphones, a comfortable sage armchair, morning light and plant shadows on the floor. Muted teal, apricot, warm cream, plum. Inviting eclectic collection, no writing on sleeves.
